config.sourceBoundary: The world publishes coarse left/right light, charge, heat, and a sign-only temporal-light comparison. No private position, peak location, charge value, heat value, or score is written to controller memory.
config.stepOrder: Each frame shows the physical state and sensors before its action; the command produces the following frame.
config.cycleDefinition: Charge reaches 80; later heat is at most 20, distance from the charger is at least 3, and charge is at least 20. This is external outcome accounting only.
worldRules: 31 cells; source relocates among 23, 6, 25, 10 every 160 ticks.
Light falls by 4 per cell from 100 at the source.
Charge change near the source: +9/+6/+3 at distance 0/1/2; elsewhere −1, with an extra −1 for actual movement.
Heat rises 5 within 2 cells, cools 4 outside; heat 90 or higher drains 3 extra charge.
Each optional spatial comparison costs 1 charge unit, accounted with that frame's action.
Starvation ticks mean charge≤5; overheat ticks mean heat≥90. Trials remain recoverable rather than terminating.
